claude.take: A genuinely differentiated asset — India's community-boiler pioneer, running 56 km of steam and nitrogen pipeline across seven Gujarat plants, which is a physical moat a competitor cannot quickly replicate — attached to the least-prepared offering of the week. Two days before the open there is no price band, no lot size, and three different issue-size figures circulating across sources. The business compounds respectably (revenue +69% over two years, RoE 22.36%) but on 1.57x leverage, and ₹180 Cr of the fresh issue simply retires debt while three capacity projects run in parallel. The RHP peer table against Linde (99x) and Ellenbarrie (43x) will make almost any band look cheap; that comparison should be discounted heavily — those are national industrial-gas majors, this is a single-state utility. Nothing here is decidable until the band prints.

company.about: Centralised industrial steam and nitrogen solutions provider, incorporated 2015, distributing via pipeline to process industries in Gujarat's chemical/textile clusters. Pioneered India's community boiler system in 2014 and extended the model to distributed nitrogen pipelines in 2025. Seven facilities across Gujarat with 56+ km of pipeline and 345 TPH steam capacity, serving clients in the Sachin, Vapi, Ankleshwar and Panoli zones.
